verdict.rationale: Goodwin's employment practice page documents that the firm develops and negotiates employment agreements and restrictive covenant agreements, which covers the core of a documented hiring-paperwork practice. Its Founders Workbench resource also includes a 'Hire' build guide. Missing for 10: explicit mention of offer letters, explicit mention of invention-assignment/confidentiality (PIIA) agreements beyond the adjacent 'restrictive covenant' category, detail on what the Hire guide contains or any templates in it, and independent corroboration.
